experiment: exp03 Arm H: QLoRA with a higher classification-head learning rate, LoRA capacity unchanged
approval: User approved Arm H only (GPU), option C: six fixed epochs, epoch 6 is the primary checkpoint; head LR 1e-3, LoRA LR 1e-4

data.split: exp01: GroupShuffleSplit(n_splits=1, test_size=0.15, random_state=42) on prompt_id over train[[id,prompt_id,text,model]] in file order
data.training_rows: all 2285 train rows; the 414 dev rows are never trained on

model.init: set_seed(42) immediately before from_pretrained (as exp01), so the score head init equals exp01's

training.optimizer: Trainer default optim (adamw_torch_fused on torch>=2.8) built via Trainer.get_optimizer_cls_and_kwargs, betas (0.9, 0.999), eps 1e-8, weight_decay 0.0 for both groups (= exp01)

head.match: trainable params whose name contains 'score' (modules_to_save copy)

training.schedule_note: Same scheduler and warmup as exp01 (Trainer defaults: linear decay to 0, no warmup). The decay now spans 6 epochs (858 steps) instead of 3 (429); each group decays from its own peak LR. Steps skipped by the fp16 GradScaler do not advance the schedule (Trainer/accelerate behaviour).
training.ga_fix: trainer.model_accepts_loss_kwargs = False after building the Trainer (the Trainer then divides each micro-batch loss by GA): logged train loss = true mean CE, grad_norm = true norm
training.eval_strategy: epoch (diagnostics only; never used to select a checkpoint)
training.save_strategy: epoch, save_only_model=True, all 6 epoch checkpoints kept
training.data_order: Trainer default RandomSampler seeded by args.seed=42

primary_checkpoint: end of epoch 6 = optimizer step 858 (the Trainer counts GradScaler-skipped steps in global_step), fixed before training. No early stopping on any metric. Per-epoch dev metrics are diagnostics only.

stop_criteria.note: Training stops early ONLY for these predefined criteria. A stopped run is reported as failed/partial; its last state is not substituted as 'epoch 6'.
stop_criteria.S1_nonfinite_loss: mean micro-batch training loss non-finite on 3 consecutive optimizer steps
stop_criteria.S2_nonfinite_grad: pre-clip total gradient norm non-finite (GradScaler skips the step) on 10 consecutive optimizer steps
stop_criteria.S3_skip_rate: cumulative GradScaler skip rate above 5% of optimizer steps, checked from optimizer step 100 onward
stop_criteria.S4_operational: CUDA OOM, Python exception, kernel crash or Kaggle session limit. The same frozen config may be relaunched after fixing an operational bug, documented in the README.

per_optimizer_step: mean micro-batch train CE (raw, before GA division)
pre-clip grad norm total and per group (head, lora)
per_epoch: dev eval_loss, balanced accuracy, macro F1, log loss (Trainer evaluate, val order, batch 8)
logging.ga_fix_check: Trainer-logged loss at each logging step vs the mean of the recorded raw micro-batch losses over the same optimizer steps (should agree to ~1e-4 relative)

post_training_epoch6.predictions: length-sorted predict loop of inference/rs2027-engs108-inference.ipynb (batch 8, fp16 autocast, eval mode): dev 414, train 2285, test rows -> logits -> softmax probabilities. These are the primary head predictions.
post_training_epoch6.hidden_states: exp02 pooled_forward (hook on score input, last non-pad token, batch 8) over train_df then dev_df order (same order as exp02 pooled_hidden_*.npy) -> pooled_hidden_armh.npy (2699 x 4096 float16) + the logits of the same pass; sha256 recorded. Test rows separately.

pre_registered_dev_reports.note: Written before training. Dev is reported once for exactly these rows; nothing is selected on dev. Each row gets bal-acc with a 23-prompt bootstrap CI, macro F1, log loss, and paired prompt-bootstrap deltas vs B1 (0.399, exp03/probe/artifacts/blend_B1_dev.csv) and vs R2 probe_exp01 (0.377). stylo_exp03 = exp03/stylo/artifacts/stylo_exp03_dev.csv.

H1.desc: trained classification head at epoch 6 (length-sorted predict loop), softmax(logits)

H2.desc: new linear probe (protocol probe: StandardScaler + LR) on epoch-6 adapted pooled hidden states; C chosen from {0.0003,0.001,0.003,0.01,0.03,0.1} by pooled train-CV OOF bal-acc on the frozen folds (ties within 0.003 -> smallest C). The CV level is optimistic: the adapter saw every train label (oof_honest false).

H6.weights: dev LOPO (protocol 5b, leave-one-prompt-out over 23 dev prompts)
H6.why_fixed_components: the 3-component LOPO pool is fixed in advance instead of 'LOPO of the best equal blend', because picking the best equal blend would itself be a dev selection; LOPO can drive any component weight to 0

diagnostics_not_reports: per-epoch dev metrics from the training log
H1 vs H2 paired delta (does the improved head catch up to the probe?)
pooled_forward logits vs length-sorted logits argmax agreement
